CogMap — self-repairing cognitive maps for robots

Phone walkthrough → world model → simulated swarm learns to navigate → the world changes → the swarm's failures repair the map → success recovers. Every map version is a W&B Weave evaluation.

Run: out/final_check · Weave project · Weave evaluations · Weave leaderboard · Weave traces
